research_question: Which of the current real ion-channel candidate symbols are listed as cycling transcripts in Abruzzi et al. (2017) S3 tables for LNv, LNd and DN1 groups?
hypothesis: Some candidate channel genes may appear in the published group-specific transcript-cycling lists, but those calls cannot by themselves establish rhythmic channel protein, current, membrane-potential or behavioral function.
alternative_hypotheses: A candidate may not have an exact-symbol entry in the selected S3 cycler tables, which does not establish that it is unexpressed or biologically arrhythmic.
A candidate may be listed only as a low-confidence cycler (LC), passing one author method but not both.
The cell-group labels may be broader than the requested subtypes and cannot resolve s-LNv from l-LNv, LNd from the fifth PDF-negative s-LNv, or individual DN subgroups.
The supplementary LNv HC total may differ from the manuscript narrative and should remain an unresolved source discrepancy unless the authors' record explains it.
preparation: Read-only cross-check of a published supplementary XLSX containing author-reported transcript-cycling calls from isolated circadian-neuron libraries; no new wet-lab data and no expression reanalysis.
cell_type: Target sheets are LNv (PDF-positive small and large LNvs mixed), LNd (includes the fifth PDF-negative s-LNv), and a DN1 subset. The TH sheet is a non-clock outgroup and is excluded from target-cell evidence.
experimental_unit: Pooled isolated-neuron library in the source study; this audit's observation is an author-reported gene-symbol row, not an independent fly-level measurement.
primary_readout: Exact-symbol presence and author-reported HC/LC classification in each target-group cycler worksheet.
secondary_readouts: Author-reported F24 score/phase and JTK p-value/phase, retained without recomputing rhythm statistics.
Per-sheet HC and LC row counts, unique-symbol counts, duplicate-symbol classes, and F24/JTK flag consistency.
Manuscript narrative HC counts compared with supplement-derived unique HC symbol counts.
time_system: Light:dark entrainment and source-reported ZT. LNv/LNd use ZT2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22; DN1 uses ZT3, 7, 11, 15, 19, 23.
required_metadata: PLOS article and S3 source identifiers, local SHA-256 and retrieval time.
Candidate source field and supplement worksheet symbol field.
Sheet-specific F24/JTK headers, author HC/LC flags, row numbers and time system.
Paper-reported HC counts, pooled-library boundaries and target cell-group limitations.
analysis_plan: Parse the XLSX ZIP/XML with Python standard-library components. Resolve each worksheet's columns by its own header text, match candidate symbols case-sensitively and exactly, retain duplicate matching rows, record author calls and metrics, compare class labels with method flags, and surface manuscript-versus-supplement count differences. Do not re-normalize expression, refit rhythms, infer aliases, or treat a missing list entry as biological absence. Export one row per candidate-by-target-group and a JSON QC report; validate provenance and replay in an isolated mirror.
decision_gate: Verify the audit only if all three target worksheets parse, every input candidate has exactly three target-group output rows when no source duplicate is present, sheet-specific headers are resolved safely, exact matches are not confused across related symbols, duplicates are retained, HC/LC calls and author flags are preserved, the LNv 249-versus-252 discrepancy is surfaced without automatic reconciliation, synthetic tests pass, all manifest hashes validate, and isolated replay reproduces both outputs.
acceptance_tests: Synthetic XLSX fixtures with LNv, LNd and DN1's different F24/JTK column orders are parsed correctly.
Exact full-symbol matching keeps Sh distinct from Shal and Shaw.
An absent symbol is reported as not listed in the source table, not as no expression or no rhythm.
Duplicate matching symbol rows are retained, and the source QC reports duplicate rows by HC/LC class.
The real audit returns 15 candidates x 3 target groups = 45 rows and finds six listed group-level entries across Sh, Shab, para, cac and sei.
The real source count check reports LNv 252 unique HC symbols versus 249 in the manuscript narrative, while LNd 303 and DN1 185 agree; it does not silently select a value.
All sheet HC/LC labels agree with their F24/JTK flags; duplicate CG40498 and Nopp140 rows are LC.
Public-dataset manifest validates and isolated replay reproduces both output hashes.

verification.synthetic_tests: 2 passed, covering dynamic worksheet header order, exact full-symbol matching, duplicate-row preservation, not-listed semantics, and ambiguous-header rejection.
verification.real_data_execution: 15 candidates x 3 target groups produced 45 candidate-group rows; six listed entries across five candidate symbols: Sh (LNd, LC), Shab (LNv, HC; DN1, LC), para (LNv, LC), cac (LNd, LC), and sei (LNv, LC).
verification.unlisted_candidates: Shaw, Shal, Irk1, na, Ca-alpha1D, Ca-alpha1T, slo, Irk2, Ork1 and trpl were not listed under exact-symbol match in these three S3 target sheets; this is not evidence of absent expression or biological arrhythmicity.
verification.source_qc: LNv 252 HC rows/252 unique HC symbols versus 249 in paper narrative; LNd 303/303; DN1 185/185. No HC/LC-flag disagreements. LNd CG40498 appears twice and DN1 Nopp140 appears three times; all duplicate rows are LC.
verification.isolated_replay: verified_public_dataset_replay; 1 run, 2 output hashes, zero issues.
verification.scientific_status: Published transcript-level rhythmicity evidence only; no rhythm statistics recomputed, no current/protein inference, no causal inference; LNv source count discrepancy remains unresolved.

limitations: S3 rows provide published symbol-level cycler calls, not transcript accessions; isoform identity cannot be resolved by this audit.
The pooled neuron libraries do not identify individual flies or support fly-level reanalysis from this table.
The reported LN cell groups do not separate s-LNv/l-LNv; LNd includes the fifth PDF-negative s-LNv; DN1 is a subset.
No exact list entry does not establish absent expression, lack of rhythmicity, or lack of channel function.
The paper narrative says 249 LNv HC cyclers while S3 contains 252 unique HC symbols; the discrepancy is unresolved.
